about:
SF Cable, Inc. operates from Hayward, California, where it has built over two decades of experience in the cable and connectivity supply business. The company does not disclose a precise founding year or founder names, nor does it state its ownership structure.

The firm functions as a wholesale distributor, stocking a broad range of power cables, data cables, adapters, and connectivity accessories. Its catalog includes HDMI cables, Cat5e and Cat6 patch cords, universal power cords (NEMA 5-15 to C13), extension cords, DB9 serial cables, USB 2.0/3.0/Type-C cables, DisplayPort cables, fiber optic trunk cables, and modular adapters. Orders placed by 1:00 PM PST ship the same day from its Hayward facility, and the company emphasizes a no-minimum-order policy.

SF Cable serves buyers across sectors that require reliable cable and interconnect solutions — IT and network infrastructure, audio/video installation, industrial equipment, and consumer electronics — though the only industry designation explicitly stated on its site is "Industry Expertise." Customers range from resellers and system integrators to end-user organizations needing quick-turn cable supplies.

The company positions its offering around five stated commitments: a lifetime warranty on all cables and non-electronics products, no minimum orders or restocking fees, 60-day money-back guarantee, free lifetime technical support, and same-day shipping on in-stock items.
